summary: The historical baseline and old replay reproduce five silent scheduled check-ins from 3am through 7am. The candidate partially improved by sending one guard-directed message at turn 11 and adding a note at turn 12, but it remained silent for turns 8–10, never requested a patrol report, and sent no outbound message at the final turn. The called-out behavior was therefore not fully fixed.

criteria.claim: The Copilot should send at least one outbound guard message instead of remaining completely quiet across all five scheduled check-ins.
The Copilot should request the patrol report during the called-out scheduled-check window.
The Copilot should check in with the guard during the scheduled-check window.
The Copilot should not lapse back into silence through the end of the shift window.

limitations: Copilot model configurations differ: old used recorded-shift-trace with maxSteps 0, while candidate used openai/gpt-5-mini with maxSteps 8.
Full replay context parity could not be independently verified because one or both replay responses omit debug context.
The supplied action_count measurement counts the candidate's add_copilot_note tool action, not its outbound guard message; message behavior was assessed from the replay references.
No simulated guard replies were present, so the replay does not establish how a real guard would have responded to the candidate's message.
